About Atlas Mobility
Atlas Mobility runs ride-hailing, bike-share and delivery services across Southeast Asia, with its regional product team based in Singapore. We are hiring a Product Lead to own the rider experience across the app.

Responsibilities
- Define the vision and roadmap for booking, pricing display, payments and in-trip experience for riders in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.
- Lead a cross-functional team of product managers, designers and engineers, setting clear goals and holding the team to them.
- Use data to find friction and opportunity: funnel conversion, cancellation rates, repeat usage and net promoter score.
- Partner with Operations, Marketplace and Pricing teams to balance rider experience with supply and unit economics.
- Run an experimentation programme and share what you learn across the business.
- Work with regional city teams to adapt features to local regulations and customer needs.
- Be the senior voice of the rider in leadership discussions.

Requirements
- 7+ years of product management experience in consumer apps, marketplaces, e-commerce or logistics.
- Demonstrated impact on conversion, retention or revenue at scale, with numbers you can talk through.
- Experience managing or mentoring product managers.
- Strong skills in prioritisation, stakeholder management and communicating trade-offs.
- Comfort working with ops-heavy businesses where product and operations meet.
- Willingness to work with regional teams across time zones.
- Singapore-based role; relocation support is available.

What we offer
A fast-moving, mission-driven team, competitive compensation and the chance to shape products used by millions of riders every week.

points.overrideText: Grew monthly active users of a retail app from 280K to 610K by rebuilding search and personalised recommendations, owning the roadmap with design and engineering
